findings.evidence: Particles/Parton/PDF/Basic.lean:169,174,178,183,220 all carry `@[simp]`; Isospin.lean:87 has no attribute, and Isospin.lean:101,132 both do `rw [f2LO_comap, Equiv.symm_swap]` manually. Mathlib/Logic/Equiv/Basic.lean:670-671 `@[simp] theorem symm_swap`.
findings.fix: Mark `@[simp] theorem f2LO_comap`. The RHS contains no `comap`, so it terminates, and with `Equiv.symm_swap` (already simp) the neutron's `f2LO e (comap (Equiv.swap u d) q)` then normalises to `f2LO (e ∘ Equiv.swap u d) q` automatically.
findings.issue: `f2LO_comap` is the characteristic interaction of `f2LO` with `comap` but carries no `@[simp]`. Every sibling comap lemma in the PDF API is simp (`comap_apply`, `comap_id`, `comap_comap`, `mellinMoment_comap`, `SumRuleAssumptions.comap_valenceTarget`), so consumers computing F₂ of a relabelled density must rewrite by hand; the PR itself does this twice (lines 101, 132).

findings.evidence: CrossSection.lean:48 `@[expose] public section`, :123 `noncomputable def f2LO`; Isospin.lean:89 `simp only [f2LO, comap_apply, Function.comp_apply]`, :102 and :133 `simp only [f2LO, Function.comp_apply]`.
findings.fix: Add the missing lemma in CrossSection.lean next to `f2LO` — `theorem f2LO_def (charge : Flavor → ℝ) (q : Flavor → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (x Q2 : ℝ) : f2LO charge q x Q2 = x * ∑ f, charge f ^ 2 * q f x Q2 := (rfl)` — and replace the three `simp only [f2LO]` with `rw`/`simp only [f2LO_def]`. Do not mark it `@[simp]`, so it does not fight `f2LO_comap`.
findings.issue: All three general proofs unfold the definition of `f2LO` (`simp only [f2LO]` at lines 89, 102, 133), relying on CrossSection.lean's `@[expose] public section` rather than on a characteristic restatement; no `f2LO_def`/`f2LO_apply` exists anywhere (grep for `f2LO` finds only `f2LO`, `f2LO_nonneg`, `loNCdSigma_f2LO_nonneg`). New public API proved by defeq-unfolding pins `f2LO`'s body and leaves consumers no way to reason about F₂ without unfolding.

summary: Surface is minimal and free of compatibility artifacts, but the file's characteristic lemma `f2LO_comap` carries no automation annotation although its direct sibling `mellinMoment_comap` is `@[simp]`, and all three proofs reach through `f2LO`'s exposed body because no `f2LO_def` restatement exists.
